Product Details: The XTRA POWER HSS Step Drill Bit is a versatile and reliable tool designed for precision metal drilling. Crafted from High Speed Steel (HSS), this step drill bit offers exceptional durability and heat resistance, making it ideal for drilling through a wide range of metals with ease. The step design allows you to drill multiple hole sizes with a single bit, eliminating the need to switch between different drill bits and saving valuable time on the job. With a size range of 4mm to 32mm, this drill bit accommodates a broad spectrum of drilling requirements, from small pilot holes to larger openings. The stepped profile ensures clean, burr-free holes with minimal effort, delivering professional-grade results every time. Suitable for use with standard power drills, this step drill bit is a must-have addition to any toolkit, whether for professional tradespeople or DIY enthusiasts. Its robust HSS construction ensures long-lasting performance even under demanding conditions.
